thread:
elaine_csm: Heads-up — Helion Wellness wants to run a 72h APAC pilot starting 2026-04-02 09:00 SGT. They requested a temporary allowlist for their on-prem egress and a QPS uplift on the singapore edge to reduce cross-region latency.

elaine_csm: Customer-provided IPs: 45.77.88.12/32, 45.77.88.13/32. Target steady QPS 15, allowance for 60 QPS bursts for up to 2 minutes. Start: 2026-04-02T09:00+08:00. TTL: 72h.

sam_net: Do we need to coordinate peering or just LB ACLs + per-customer rate profile?

devin_platform: LB ACL + per-customer rate profile should be enough if traffic leaves from those IPs. If they request peering later, account ops will need a different ticket.

elaine_csm: org_id: hel-550, route: /api/v2/healthcheck (hosted on redwood-sg-edge-2). They're in a pilot mode so payloads will be small.

sam_net: Creating INFRA ticket and tagging infra-bot. Please include rollback contact and billing note.

infra-bot: Ticket INFRA-2084 created — "Helion Wellness: temporary allowlist + QPS increase on sg-edge-2". Owner: @sam_net. ETA LB rule: 90m. Policy rollout ready for canary within 30m.

lydia_billing: FYI — this will be covered by pilot credits for first 48h; after that normal metering applies. I'll message customer about potential overage and need for billing opt-in if they extend.

devin_platform: Proposed policy blob for ops:
```json
{
  "customer_id": "hel-550",
  "route": "/api/v2/healthcheck",
  "edge": "sg",
  "baseline_qps": "15",
  "burst_qps": "60",
  "burst_window_sec": "120",
  "allowlist": ["45.77.88.12/32","45.77.88.13/32"],
  "expires_at": "2026-04-05T09:05:00+08:00",
  "auto_revoke": "true",
  "notes": "72h pilot. Billing contact: lydia_billing@redwood.com"
}
```

devin_platform: Plan is to canary on 5% traffic on sg-edge-2 then promote. Will add header X-Policy-Canary during rollout so we can track metrics.

sam_net: LB ACLs applied (INFRA-2084). Pls verify from customer IPs.

helion_sre (external): Testing now from 45.77.88.12 — curl returns 200 and header x-redwood-edge: sg. Latency looks much better.

devin_platform: Canary completed, promoting to 100% on sg-edge-2. Policy-id pol-8120.

infra-bot: Deployment success: pol-8120 active on sg-edge-2. Auto-revoke scheduled for 2026-04-05T09:10+08:00.

elaine_csm: Customer notes: 95th p95 dropped from ~480ms to ~150ms. They asked whether we can document a minimal peering checklist for future pilots. Also asked about Dedicated pool options if they scale. Captured feedback.

lydia_billing: Noted. I'll follow up on billing options and outline free pilot limits vs committed capacity pricing.

devin_platform: Left auto-revoke and alert to account-ops. If Helion requests extension, we need written approval and RB for Dedicated if they want guaranteed throughput.

sam_net: Operational note: INFRA-2084 resolved (ACLs live, policy active, revoke job scheduled).

elaine_csm: Actions: (1) devin — add a 1-paragraph peering checklist to onboarding.wiki by EOD; (2) lydia — send billing opt-in email before 48h; (3) sam — confirm revoke automation and mark for manual review at expiry.

devin_platform: Will add sample policy snippet and peering checklist.

lydia_billing: I'll draft the billing note and include estimated cost at current QPS.

sam_net: Revoke automation verified — will send reminder to account team 10m after expiry.

infra-bot: INFRA-2084 marked resolved.

elaine_csm: Thanks all — Ill loop back to Helion with next steps and close when billing confirms. :white_check_mark:
